original8_scope.limitations: Eight temporal samples from one episode; disjoint times are not independent episodes or task SR.

heldout8_scope.limitations: Eight temporal samples from one episode; disjoint times are not independent episodes or task SR.

interpretation: Adam moments measure gradient history, not a particular current backward call.
B-zero initialization normally gives zero first-step A gradient and nonzero B gradient.
Frozen-weight equality and gradient counts are existing run-report receipts, not recomputed full-model checks.
Original eight states can be used for KV anchoring; heldout eight are evaluation-only times in the same expert episode.
Neither local retention gate nor text fitting measures robot success or visual grounding generalization.

retention_original8.scope: Eight fixed observation time points from one expert episode; same three RGB cameras, state, original instruction and stored noise. Local retention only, not rollout SR.
